fact: The Centre Marocain de Médiation Bancaire's mediation rules of 23 March 2023 govern a mediation scheme binding its members, which include banks, financing companies and payment institutions, under a Bank Al-Maghrib circular of 2016.
system: Centre Marocain de Médiation Bancaire (Al Wassit Al Banki)

fact: The Moroccan banking mediation centre Al Wassit Albanki, set up under Bank Al-Maghrib, received 5,536 complaint files in 2024, of which disputes over payment means (cards 57.35%, transfers 29.08%) were 21.16% of those treated, and payment institutions and money transfer companies were among the institutions concerned.
